research_question: With the frozen V86 treatment settings actually held constant, does stale recent-opening conflict projection recover both known candidate-gate failures without changing any other gate decision?

scope.dataset_role: corrected confirmatory replay of a known-failure deterministic gate regression

conditions.c0_projection_disabled: Replay each frozen V86 treatment reply with canonical memory cues and explicit length enabled, but forbidden-conflict projection disabled.
conditions.t1_projection_enabled: Replay the identical reply and plan with the same fixed settings and only forbidden-conflict projection enabled.

controls: same twelve V86 treatment replies byte-for-byte
canonical memory cues explicitly true in both conditions
explicit length contract explicitly true in both conditions
same frozen target plans, maximum character budgets, and candidate gate
no generation, benchmark item, answer, prompt tuning, or score override
no production memory writes or VRM actions
evidence_boundary: A pass confirms only the candidate-gate mechanism on the twelve frozen V86 replies under corrected controls. It cannot establish fresh generation quality or production readiness; a disjoint full-pipeline V88 holdout remains mandatory.
